title.zh: 规定在新比斯开省Bayombong市镇设立淡水示范渔场与苗种场并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Fresh-Water Demonstration Fish Farm and Nursery in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, and Authoring the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Fresh-Water Demonstration Fish Farm and Nursery in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, and Authoring the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3894_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established under the supervision of the Commissioner of Fisheries, a fresh-water demonstration fish farm and nursery in the Municipality of Bayombong, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, to be known as Bayombong Fish Farm and Nursery.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry into effect the purpose of this Act during the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and sixty-five. Thereafter, the sum of thirty thousand pesos for the operation and maintenance of the said project shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
